value.pv.jsonata:
(
  $s := $input; $d := $s.estimateS ? $s.estimateS : 0; $m := $floor($d / 60);
  $b := $s.bbox;
  $c := function($fx, $fy){ $b ? {"x": $round($b.x + $fx * $b.w, 2), "y": $round($b.y + $fy * $b.h, 2)} : {} };
  {
    "pret": $s.ready = true ? "oui" : "non",
    "taille": $s.sizeMm ? $formatNumber($s.sizeMm.w, '0.#') & " × " & $formatNumber($s.sizeMm.h, '0.#') & " mm" : "—",
    "duree": $s.ready ? ($m >= 60 ? $string($floor($m / 60)) & " h " & $formatNumber($m % 60, '00') : $string($m) & " min " & $formatNumber($round($d % 60), '00')) : "—",
    "lignes": $s.ready ? $string($s.lines) : "—",
    "aDesCouleurs": ($count($s.colors) > 0 and $not($s.kind = 'image')) ? "oui" : "non",
    "nbCouleurs": $string($count($s.colors)),
    "renduLib": $lookup({"gray": "Niveaux de gris", "floyd": "Diffusion (Floyd)", "atkinson": "Atkinson", "jarvis": "Jarvis", "stucki": "Stucki", "burkes": "Burkes", "sierra": "Sierra", "sierra-lite": "Sierra léger", "bayer": "Trame ordonnée", "random": "Bruit", "threshold": "Seuil", "adaptive": "Seuil local", "hatch": "Hachures croisées", "waves": "Ondes", "spiral": "Spirale", "isolines": "Lignes de niveau", "stipple": "Pointillisme", "aplats": "Aplats vectoriels"}, $rendu), "effetLib": $lookup({"aucun": "Aucun", "contours": "Contours (Sobel)", "encre": "Encre", "trait": "Dessin au trait", "crayon": "Crayonné", "peinture": "Peinture", "aplatsfx": "Aplats", "hachuresfx": "Hachures", "points": "Points", "trame": "Trame", "gravurefx": "Gravure", "bd": "Bande dessinée", "negatif": "Négatif"}, $effet),
    "avecEffet": $effet != 'aucun' ? "oui" : "non",
    "renduTraits": $rendu in ['hatch', 'waves', 'spiral', 'stipple'] ? "oui" : "non",
    "renduSeuil": $rendu in ['threshold', 'adaptive', 'floyd', 'atkinson', 'jarvis', 'stucki', 'burkes', 'sierra', 'sierra-lite', 'bayer', 'random'] ? "oui" : "non",
    "renduBalayage": $rendu in ['gray', 'floyd', 'atkinson', 'jarvis', 'stucki', 'burkes', 'sierra', 'sierra-lite', 'bayer', 'random', 'threshold', 'adaptive'] ? "oui" : "non",
    "coins": {"hg": $c(0, 1), "h": $c(0.5, 1), "hd": $c(1, 1), "g": $c(0, 0.5), "c": $c(0.5, 0.5), "d": $c(1, 0.5), "bg": $c(0, 0), "b": $c(0.5, 0), "bd": $c(1, 0)},
    "centrePlateau": $s.sizeMm ? {"x": $round((410 - $s.sizeMm.w) / 2, 1), "y": $round((400 - $s.sizeMm.h) / 2, 1)} : {},
    "resume": $s.ready ? ("Dessin de " & ($s.sizeMm ? $formatNumber($s.sizeMm.w, '0.#') & " × " & $formatNumber($s.sizeMm.h, '0.#') & " mm" : "?") & ", environ " & ($m >= 60 ? $string($floor($m / 60)) & " h " & $formatNumber($m % 60, '00') : $string($m < 1 ? 1 : $m) & " min") & ".") : "",
    "notice": $s.error ? $s.error : ""
  }
)
value.svg-actif.jsonata:
(
  $mode = 'svg' ? ($input.url or $input.svg ? $input : null) :
  $mode = 'modeles' ? ($modele.svg ? {"svg": $modele.svg} : null) :
  ($mode = 'image' and ($photoType = 'trait' or $rendu = 'aplats')) ? ($vec ? {"svg": $vec} : null) :
  $mode = 'procgen' ? ($pg ? {"svg": $pg} : null) :
  null
)
